after_full_value.synonym_text: Iron ammonium sulfate hydrate

alias_claims.rationale: Retain Iron ammonium sulfate hydrate and Fe(NH4)2(SO4)2 as non-resolving global provenance on the exact hexahydrate owner. The former is only related in CHEBI76181 and omits oxidation/hydration scope; the bare formula has actual anhydrous and seven-water alternative owners. Preserve the supported source-specific MediaDive106 interpretation because its independent CAS7783-85-9 and six-water formula disambiguate that occurrence. A source-qualified interpretation is not an unconditional resolver synonym. Keep all supported explicit six-water aliases and earlier concentration-label rejections.
